contract: {"interface":{"mode":"stdin_stdout","signature":"stdin -> stdout"},"preconditions":[{"id":"P1","expression":"1 <= len(m) <= 100000","description":"The length of the mask m must be between 1 and 100,000."},{"id":"P2","expression":"all(c in '#_' for c in m)","description":"The mask m must consist only of the characters '#' and '_'."}],"postconditions":[{"id":"Q1","expression":"stdout == '-1' if any(m[i] == '#' and m[i+1] == '#' for i in range(len(m)-1)) else True","description":"If there are consecutive '#' characters in the mask, output -1."},{"id":"Q2","expression":"stdout == '0' if m == '_' * len(m) else True","description":"If the mask consists entirely of '_' characters, output 0."},{"id":"Q3","expression":"stdout == f'{len(profile)}\n{" ".join(map(str, profile))}' if profile else True","description":"If a valid profile is found, output the number of integers in the profile followed by the integers themselves."}],"invariants":[]}
